sol.name: Sol
sol.thesis: Stay flat: elevated real yields and imminent CPI/FOMC event risk offer no sufficiently verified, asymmetric setup on 2026-09-10.
sol.justification: The book has no positions to hold or sell, and the supplied research feed is stale or internally inconsistent while prices lack the constitutionally required second-source verification. With CPI on September 15 and the FOMC immediately afterward, opening directional exposure now would rely more on event prediction than demonstrated edge; preserve capital in cash.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Event-week (CPI Sep 15, FOMC Sep 16-17) with a steep 2s10s, 10Y at 4.80%, and a one-day semiconductor washout is not a mispricing; cash at ~3.6% front-end is the position until a falsifiable edge exists.
grok.justification: Book is flat, no open theses to re-underwrite, and the next five sessions are dominated by two scheduled macro prints that are already in the option surface. Semis (NVDA/AMD/MU/INTC) sold off together — that is a factor move, not a single-name dislocation we can underwrite. No three-sentence test clears: no named payer of alpha, no structural constraint, no behavioral overshoot with a dated invalidation that is independent of guessing CPI. Per constitution, inventing risk to race 10x would be a process failure; survive, stay measured, wait.

qwen.name: Qwen
qwen.thesis: Flat before the Sep 15 CPI and mid-September FOMC window: event risk is two-sided and no mispricing clears costs and risk limits.
qwen.justification: The tape shows isolated strength in cybersecurity and weakness in semis, but no high-conviction structural, analytical, informational, or behavioral edge with a clean falsifier before major macro prints. With 10Y at 4.80%, VIX at 16.5, and near-term catalysts likely to reprice rates and tech beta, paying for convexity or taking directional beta is not attractive. Preserving capital and waiting for post-event confirmation is the highest-expected-value action under the risk constitution.

glm.name: GLM
glm.thesis: Late-ease, steep-curve regime: the front end (2Y 4.39% vs funds 3.63%) prices a hawkish pause the Fed hasn't signaled — own the curve's equity expression (financials) and a small washed-out BTC liquidity position, and stay flat the semi unwind that can't be underwritten on stale data.
glm.justification: Existing XLF was reviewed first: 2s10s at +41bp and steepening with the Fed mid-ease at 3.63% keeps the bank-NIM thesis intact and XLF showed relative strength on a red tape, so I hold and top it to 9% (36bps risk at the -4% stop, inside the 50bps/position cap). The research feed is 15 days stale (Aug-26 vintage), so today's -3% to -5% semi tape has no verifiable driver — no knife-catch long and no chase short — and the only underwritable new idea is small BTC at post-drawdown levels against hawkishly-priced front end; CPI (Sep 15) and FOMC (Sep 16) sit inside both horizons, so 88% cash is deliberate. Note: the 10x-in-one-year target implies ~900%, incompatible with the 15% max-drawdown tolerance and ¼-Kelly sizing; that mandate conflict is logged and the constitution binds — today's sizing is survival-first, not race-first.

The upcoming CPI report on Sep 15 and FOMC meeting on Sep 17 are likely to be significant drivers of market direction in the near term.

kimi.justification: The QQQ and MU puts are working and their invalidations have not triggered, so they are held per pre-stated rules rather than improvised exits; adding fresh semis puts after a -3-5% flush day would be chasing and would concentrate the book in one correlation cluster (three expressions of 'semis fall' is one bet). The only new position is a small VXX long put: the vol risk premium is a documented structural edge, VXX futures already price the CPI/FOMC bump, and post-event convergence plus contango bleed favor decay over 45 days — it also partially offsets the equity puts if events pass quietly. Everything else today (crypto, energy, one-day relative-strength names like AAPL/F/QCOM) lacks an underwritable edge, so ~93% stays in cash; with equity at $97.8k and binary event risk ahead, survival and honest sizing dominate the race framing.
